reviews.text:
My wife and I are so happy with our swimming pool improvements.  Our 40yr old pool needed a face-lift.  I reached out to Elite Swimming Pool & Spa Service for help.  I had a phone conversation with Angelo.  It was a very engaged and informative conversation.  A few weeks later we visited with him at our home .  He's a very professional and personable gentleman.  In less than an hour we had a plan to revive our swimming pool.  He suggested replastering, new tile, and mastic replacement...
He said it would be finished in 10 days.  That was perfect for our scheduled family gathering.  It was done in less than 10 days!  Our family had a fantastic time in our new swimming pool oasis.  It's beautiful and we are so happy!  Thanks to Angelo and his amazing crew at Elite Swimming Pool and Spa Service!  Check out our before and after pictures.
reviews.author: Lynn Sells

reviews.text: Replaced tiles around top edge. Repaired coping bricks. Angelo was very responsive, good to communicate promptly and clearly. Juan drained pool one day, removed old tiles second day, placed new tiles and grouted third day and was done. He is an artist at his work.  Cleaned up the site completely. Angelo came after pool filled to vacuum, clear surface debris and add chemicals. Very, very polite and respectful. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Tom Tyner

reviews.text: Elite did a complete remodel Coping, Tile and Plaster on our 17 yr old pool.   They did a great job.  finished in  less then 2 weeks.   I got 5 bids on the work Elite was competitive on the price, I choose Elite based on the reviews I read, and I was not disappointed.  Angelo responded to all texts and phone calls quickly,  He answered all my questions and took care of every aspect of the remodel perfectly.  We love our new pool.
reviews.author: Lana Kratz

reviews.text: Elite Pools resurfaced our pool 10/2023 for a fair price. The work was done as scheduled and, most importantly, the follow-up over the next 3 weeks was outstanding. I highly recommend contacting Angelo about your pool needs.
reviews.author: Matt Harness

reviews.text: Awesome job on our remodel.  Angelo is very responsive and very much a perfectionist.  They were there on time every day and worked long hours to get the job done.  When we asked for some changes in the middle, they worked with us no problem!  They do amazing stone and tile work--our pool looks great. They also worked an extra day on preparing our pool for plaster as our last plaster job ended up with hollow spots.  I am confident we won't have that issue with Elite.  And finish work was attended to by Angelo personally, where his attention to detail was so valuable.  I would highly recommend them for your pool remodel.  Honest, trustworthy, good at what they do and they do the job right and are not satisfied until the customer is.
reviews.author: Mark Bailey

reviews.text: I HIGHLY recommend Elite Swimming Pool & Spa. We were ready to have this pool filled in but Elite made it brand new again!!!  I called several companies, left messages and even spoke to some who said they would come out to see what repairs needed to be done. NO ONE CALLED BACK OR SHOWED UP except for Angelo at ELITE!! He was friendly, knowledgeable, stayed in contact, responded quickly to text messages and was there to HELP us!!  Thank you ELITE Swimming Pool & Spa.....But mostly THANK YOU ANGELO!!!!!
reviews.author: Mike Mongognia

reviews.text: We have had them service our pool and spa for the last 4 years. We have a weekly schedule and they keep us clean and in working order all year long. If we have an issue or a problem like a pool equipment breaking down, they have always been very responsive and get repairs done quickly. They are the best and so glad they have been our pool people the last few years!!
reviews.author: Chelly Vinson

reviews.text: We love our new mini pebble. It has brought our pool back to life. The work was completed quickly and is something we will enjoy for years. I highly recommend Elite!
reviews.author: Barbara Powell
